history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration enhance the performance of fund utilization under the cost-recovery fund (10RCR) to contribute to improved mandate delivery.
history.administration_response: The recommendation was implemented. With the submission of the report of the Secretary-General on cost recovery in the United Nations Secretariat (A/80/369), the Administration addressed the Board’s findings and recommendation by providing details of the recommended thorough review of cost recovery carried out, including on the financial performance of cost-recovery funds.
history.board_assessment: Given that the report of the Secretary-General on cost recovery in the United Nations Secretariat (A/80/369) has been submitted, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
